query: select market,game_id,player_id,game_date,game_time,quote_updated_at,captured_at,checksum,payload from worker_pregame_originals where sport='nhl' and market in ('goals','assists') and game_date between '2026-11-09' and '2026-11-13' order by market,game_date,game_id,player_id;
source: Read-only worker_pregame_originals; all quote rows, not selected picks
